subject: sentences
title: Which group?
about: Sorting words into groups (animals, colors, foods, clothes, vehicles) and solving little riddles that define a word by its group and one clue, like a bird that swims. This is NC L.1.5, done with adult support in class.
tip: After he answers, ask him to name one more thing that belongs in the same group.

cards.note: A fox is an animal. A fork and a flag are things.
Blue is a color. Big tells a size. A bus is a thing.
Bread is a food you can eat. A bed and a brush are not food.
A sock is clothing. You wear it on your foot.
A circle is a shape. A cat is an animal. A car is a thing.
Six is a number. Sad is a feeling. Sip is something you do.

cards.q: Apple, grape, pear. Which one belongs with them?
cards.note: Apple, grape, pear and plum are all fruits.

cards.q: Dog, cat, pig. Which one belongs with them?
cards.note: Dog, cat, pig and hen are all animals.

cards.q: Bus, car, van. Which one belongs with them?
cards.note: Bus, car, van and truck all drive on the road. They are vehicles.

cards.q: Red, blue, green. Which one belongs with them?
cards.note: Red, blue, green and pink are all colors. Ink and wink are not color words.

cards.q: I am a bird that swims. What am I?
cards.note: A duck is a bird that swims. Hens and owls are birds too, but they do not swim like a duck.

cards.q: I am a fruit that is yellow and long. What am I?
cards.note: A banana is a fruit that is yellow and long.

cards.q: I am an animal that says moo. What am I?
cards.note: A cow is an animal that says moo.

cards.q: I am a pet that barks. What am I?
cards.note: A dog is a pet that barks. Cats meow. Fish are quiet.

cards.q: I am a thing you sleep in. What am I?
cards.note: A bed is a thing you sleep in. You drink from a cup and swim in a pool.
